FINAL SQL:
SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name, r.ranking_points
FROM players p
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE p.player_id = (
    SELECT winner_id
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.ranking_date DESC
LIMIT 1
